component: Calendar localization migration and branding consumers

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This conversion replaces owned positional string arguments with Fluent names and branding terms. Title localization receives docTitle; the storage message retains fileName, and storage/invitation services load branding/brand.ftl. The migration maps old placeholders and deliberately leaves the renamed schema message unmigrated when its hostApplication argument becomes a term. Later accepted authentication uses calendarName/location rather than the owned username/location phase. No migration, title, database or native localization run verifies these declarations.
title: The Calendar Fluent conversion maps named arguments and imports branding terms
